column_description: INTEGER. Unique identifier for the constructor. PK. Example: 1.
TEXT. Constructor reference code. Example: mclaren.
VARCHAR. Full team name. **NULL means the constructor name has not been resolved or released.**. Example: McLaren.
VARCHAR. Nationality of the constructor. **NULL means the team's nationality is not specified in the dataset.**. Example: British.
VARCHAR. URL to the constructor's page. **NULL means the reference link is missing.**. Example: http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/BMW_Sauber.
